label: Avs I system
definition: An AVAST system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded subtype I locus represented by DefenseFinder with Avs1A, Avs1B, and Avs1C profiles.
observations: Avs subtype I branch under AVAST system; distinct from the broader AVAST system, individual Avs1A, Avs1B, and Avs1C proteins, individual DefenseFinder Avs_I profile rows, unresolved Avs I effector chemistry, Avs II through Avs V subtypes, and other phage-defense systems.
